verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's official MCP server lets an AI assistant query live OpenRouter data (models, prices, credits, rankings, docs) and send test messages from the editor through natural-language prompts. A published agent skill can also handle SDK migration updates. However, documented natural-language operation is limited to lookups and test calls; managing keys, budgets, routing and privacy settings is evidenced only through API/request parameters and settings pages. Missing for 10: natural-language control of account and admin operations (keys, budgets, routing/privacy settings), a native in-product natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP-based workflow.
